model.algorithm: word+character TF-IDF eight-signal one-vs-rest logistic regression plus whole-message word TF-IDF scam-intent logistic regression, protective-context suppression, bounded QR context boost, deterministic L4 policy

development_history: The first v1 final-test opening exposed a 0.166667 false-positive rate caused by negated safety warnings.
That failure was retained as error analysis and led to the protective-context layer.
The test templates are therefore a regression set, not an untouched external benchmark.
limitations: Synthetic performance is not production performance.
Scenario coverage does not guarantee coverage of future wording or attack mechanics.
Deepfake, receipt, QR, caller, URL, phone, account, and transaction verification require the other architecture layers.
The model has not passed a frozen, permitted, human-labelled real-message golden set.
The probability prior must be recalibrated on real Vietnamese traffic before production.
